data_provenance.opening_placed_odds: home_odds, draw_odds, away_odds (Market maximum available early lines)
data_provenance.closing_benchmark_odds: closing_home_odds, closing_draw_odds, closing_away_odds (Pinnacle Closing: PSCH, PSCD, PSCA recorded at kickoff)
data_provenance.pinnacle_opening_odds: pinnacle_open_home, pinnacle_open_draw, pinnacle_open_away (Pinnacle Opening: PSH, PSD, PSA recorded mid-week)
data_provenance.bet365_opening_odds: b365_open_home, b365_open_draw, b365_open_away (Bet365 Opening: B365H, B365D, B365A)
data_provenance.average_closing_odds: closing_avg_home, closing_avg_draw, closing_avg_away (Market Average Closing: AvgCH, AvgCD, AvgCA)

provenance_forensic_note: Previous v1 release incorrectly mapped PSH/PSD/PSA as closing odds. In football-data.co.uk data dictionary, PSH/PSD/PSA are Pinnacle pre-closing (opening) lines, while PSCH/PSCD/PSCA are Pinnacle closing lines recorded at kickoff. Corrected in v2 release to eliminate artificial margin bias.
